35334-folk-lore-and-legends-oriental.title: Folk Lore And Legends Oriental
35334-folk-lore-and-legends-oriental.creator: Unknown
35334-folk-lore-and-legends-oriental.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. In the great city of Isfahan lived Ahmed the cobbler, an honest and industrious man, whose wish was to pass through life quietly; and he might have done so, had he not married a handsome wife, who, although she had condescended to accept of him as a husband, was far from being contented with his humble sphere of life.

arxiv-2106-08863.title: Unbiased Methods for Multi-Goal RL
arxiv-2106-08863.creator: Léonard Blier, Yann Ollivier
arxiv-2106-08863.description: Abstract In multi-goal reinforcement learning (RL) settings, the reward for each goal is sparse, and located in a small neighborhood of the goal. In large dimension, the probability of reaching a reward vanishes and the agent receives little learning signal. Methods such as Hindsight Experience Replay (HER) tackle this issue by also learning from realized but unplanned-for goals.

arxiv-2109-03199.title: Unsupervised Conversation Disentanglement through Co-Training
arxiv-2109-03199.creator: Hui Liu, Zhan Shi, Xiaodan Zhu
arxiv-2109-03199.description: Abstract Conversation disentanglement aims to separate intermingled messages into detached sessions, which is a fundamental task in understanding multi-party conversations. Existing work on conversation disentanglement relies heavily upon human-annotated datasets, which are expensive to obtain in practice. In this work, we explore to train a conversation disentanglement model without referencing any human annotations.

arxiv-2204-05182.title: Towards Understanding Analytics in Software Startups Conference: 5th International Workshop on Software-intensive Business: Towards Sustainable Software Business; May 18, 2022; Pittsburgh, PA, USA 5th International Workshop on Software-intensive Business: Towards Sustainable Software Business (IWSiB
arxiv-2204-05182.creator: Usman Rafiq
arxiv-2204-05182.description: Abstract . Analytics plays a crucial role in the data-informed decision-making processes of modern businesses. Unlike established software companies, software startups are not seen utilizing the potential of analytics even though a startup process should be primarily data-driven. There has been little understanding in the literature about analytics for software startups.

arxiv-2210-17241.title: Distributed optimization on directed graphs based on inexact ADMM with partial participation
arxiv-2210-17241.creator: Dingran Yi, Nikolaos M. Freris
arxiv-2210-17241.description: Abstract We consider the problem of minimizing the sum of cost functions pertaining to agents over a network whose topology is captured by a directed graph (i.e., asymmetric communication). We cast the problem into the ADMM setting, via a consensus constraint, for which both primal subproblems are solved inexactly.

arxiv-2311-04289.title: Parameter Tuning in the Radial Kernel-Based Partition of Unity Method by Bayesian Optimization Journal: Journal of Computational and Applied Mathematics
arxiv-2311-04289.creator: Roberto Cavoretto, Alessandra De Rossi, Sandro Lancellotti, Federico Romaniello
arxiv-2311-04289.description: Abstract In this paper, we employ Bayesian optimization to concurrently explore the optimal values for both the shape parameter and the radius in the partition of unity interpolation using radial basis functions. Bayesian optimization is a probabilistic, iterative approach that models the error function through a progressively self-updated Gaussian process.

arxiv-2503-06954.title: Approximate Size Targets Are Sufficient for Accurate Semantic Segmentation
arxiv-2503-06954.creator: Xingye Fan, Zhongwen (Rex) Zhang, Yuri Boykov
arxiv-2503-06954.description: Abstract This paper demonstrates a surprising result for segmentation with image-level targets: extending binary class tags to approximate relative object-size distributions allows off-the-shelf architectures to solve the segmentation problem. A straightforward zero-avoiding KL-divergence loss for average predictions produces segmentation accuracy comparable to the standard pixel-precise supervision with full ground truth masks.

pmc-10542667.creator: Hayley J. Lowther-Payne, Anastasia Ushakova, Adelaide Beckwith, Catherine Liberty, Rhiannon Edge, Fiona Lobban
pmc-10542667.description: BackgroundPopulation groups experience differential access to timely and high-quality mental healthcare. Despite efforts of recent UK policies to improve the accessibility of mental health services, there remains a lack of comprehensive understanding of inequalities in access to services needed to do this.

pmc-11394551.title: Salt-Reduced Fish Sauce Produced under Pressurized Carbon Dioxide Treatment Using Sardinops melanostictus, Trachurus japonicus, Konosirus punctatus, Odontamblyopus lacepedii, Their Collective Mixture, and Unused Fish Mixture
pmc-11394551.creator: Johma Tagawa, Mikihide Demura, Seiji Noma
pmc-11394551.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). Fish sauce is produced at high salt concentrations (>20%) to inhibit the growth of harmful microorganisms. The salt-reduced fish sauce (10% salt) was prepared under pressurized CO2 (pCO2) conditions at 30 °C and 5 MPa for 3 months (FSCO2), from Sardinops melanostictus, Odontamblyopus lacepedii, Trachurus japonicus, Konosirus punctatus, and their collective mixture, as well as unused fish mixture obtained from the Ariake Sea in Japan.

pmc-12457945.title: Granulomatous lobular mastitis in pregnancy: report of 29 cases
pmc-12457945.creator: Hongyi Liang, Guangxi Shi, Hanhan Chen, Xiaofei Liu, Zhe Zhang, Aili Song, Jingwei Li
pmc-12457945.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). Granulomatous lobular mastitis (GLM) is a rare inflammatory breast disease, and there are few reports of GLM in pregnancy (GLMIP). Therefore, this study retrospectively analyzed cases diagnosed with GLMIP from 2011 to 2023 and found that in patients with GLMIP there were varied demographic manifestations such as age, pregnancy weeks, and numbers of pregnancy and delivery, and several associated complications including erythema nodosum, arthritis and lower extremity edema.

pmc-12537841.title: Comparative Mitogenomics of Andini (Hemiptera: Cixiidae) Reveals Rapid Radiation, Clarifies Relationships, and Supports Taxonomic Revision Within the Tribe
pmc-12537841.creator: Sha‐Sha Lv, Thierry Bourgoin, Xiao‐Ya Wang, Lin Yang, Yu‐Bo Zhang, Xiang‐Sheng Chen
pmc-12537841.description: Mitochondrial genomes from nine species representing three genera of the planthopper tribe Andini (Hemiptera: Cixiidae) are sequenced and analyzed, providing the first mitogenomic data for this group. The mitogenomes range from 15,415 to 15,902 bp and contain 37 typical mitochondrial genes and an A + T‐rich region, with A + T content between 73.5% and 76.0%.

pmc-12985930.title: Pericarditis in Patients with Autoimmune Disease: Insights into Prevalence and Optimal Management
pmc-12985930.creator: Yeva Fakikh, SaraH Kazzaz, Maan Malahfji
pmc-12985930.description: Initially recognized as a key cardiac feature of systemic lupus erythematosus and rheumatoid arthritis, autoimmune pericarditis has gained increasing attention given the recent advances in cardiac imaging, biomarker assessment, and understanding of immune-mediated mechanisms. The prevalence of pericardial involvement varies considerably among autoimmune diseases.

pmc-13257285.title: Response of Psychrotolerant Fungus Mucor flavus to Cell Wall Stress, Induced by Azo Dyes
pmc-13257285.creator: Sofiya A. Saharova, Elena A. Ianutsevich, Olga A. Danilova, Galina A. Kochkina, Vera M. Tereshina
pmc-13257285.description: The cell wall (CW) of Mucoromycota has a unique chitin/chitosan complex, unlike chitin/glucan complex in Ascomycota. Under cell wall stress (CWS), induced by azo dyes, ascomycetes increase the amount of CW chitin. This study analyzes the response of Mucor flavus to CWS, induced by Congo red and Calcofluor white.

pmc-13414127.title: Nystose treats intervertebral disc degeneration via the Nrf2 axis: a focus on oxidative stress and ferroptosis
pmc-13414127.creator: Haifeng Mei, Xiuxiu Zheng, Dawei Han, Tao Xia, Yuhua Guo
pmc-13414127.description: BackgroundIntervertebral disc degeneration (IDD) is the primary aetiology of chronic lower back pain and is driven by factors such as oxidative stress and nucleus pulposus (NP) cell dysfunction. Nystose (Nys), a key active oligosaccharide derived from Morinda officinalis How., has shown potential in treating degenerative diseases; however, its specific effect and underlying mechanism of action in IDD remain largely unexplored.

pmc-13559185.title: Gram-negative aetiology in hip and knee prosthetic joint infections: risk factors and implications for empirical antibiotic therapy—a retrospective cohort study
pmc-13559185.creator: Sara Tedeschi, Marta Fernandez-Sampedro, Eleonora Zamparini, Nicolò Rossi, Giuseppe Ferraro, Alberto Pecorelli, Giacomo Fornaro, Maria Pia Neri, Cesare Faldini, Stefano Zaffagnini, Massimiliano De Paolis, Alessandra Maso, Simone Ambretti, Maddalena Giannella, Pierluigi Viale
pmc-13559185.description: BackgroundEmpirical broad-spectrum antibiotic therapy is currently recommended for patients undergoing surgical treatment of prosthetic joint infections (PJIs), while awaiting intraoperative culture results. However, widespread use of Gram-negative coverage may lead to more adverse reactions, resistance selections and costs.ObjectivesThis study aimed to identify the factors associated with having a PJI caused by Gram-negative bacteria (GNB).

pmc-13685336.title: Persian version of the international consultation on incontinence questionnaire-pediatric lower urinary tract symptoms caregiver module: translation, validation and cultural adaptation
pmc-13685336.creator: Mahdi Norouzi, Elham Aghaei, Farshid Alizadeh, Jalil Hosseini, Mahtab Zargham, Farshad Gholipour
pmc-13685336.description: BackgroundCurrently, the International Consultation on Incontinence Questionnaire–Pediatric Lower Urinary Tract Symptoms (ICIQ-CLUTS), a well-established tool for assessing LUTS in children, is not available in Persian. This study aims to translate and validate this tool for Persian-speaking caregivers.MethodsThe ICIQ-CLUTS was translated and validated following ICIQ recommendations. The final version was self-administered by 67 caregivers of children aged 5 to 9 years.

uslaw-usc-t22-s2722.title: 22 U.S.C. § 2722 — International meetings
uslaw-usc-t22-s2722.creator: United States Congress
uslaw-usc-t22-s2722.description: United States Code, Title 22 (Foreign Relations And Intercourse); Chapter 38 (Department Of State). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. (a) Authority to pay expenses If the United States Government hosts an international meeting or conference in the United States, the Secretary of State is authorized to pay all reasonable expenses of such meeting or conference. Such expenses may include rental of quarters.
